recognize_zh: 脾臟切片低倍下紅髓被單調的小至中型淋巴細胞瀰漫浸潤，白髓不明顯，細胞間散佈許多紅血球湖（blood lakes），這是毛細胞白血病及其變異型典型的紅髓浸潤樣式。
features: Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells expanding the red pulp
Cells have round-to-oval nuclei with moderate pale cytoplasm giving a spaced-out appearance
Numerous irregular red cell collections (pseudosinuses/blood lakes) scattered among the infiltrate
White pulp not discernible; no nodular architecture
Individual nucleoli not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Splenic section at low-to-medium power shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round-to-oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm. Numerous red cell-filled spaces (blood lakes) are scattered throughout, and discrete white pulp nodules are not identified. Nucleolar detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with red pulp involvement by a small B-cell neoplasm such as hairy cell leukemia variant; distinction from classic HCL requires peripheral blood morphology (prominent nucleoli), immunophenotype (CD25, annexin A1, CD123 negative) and BRAF V600E status.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL has an identical red pulp pattern with blood lakes but is CD25, CD123, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive, whereas HCL variant lacks these.
SMZL predominantly expands the white pulp with a biphasic nodular pattern and marginal zone differentiation rather than diffuse red pulp infiltration.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shares diffuse red pulp involvement and CD25/annexin A1 negativity, so separation from HCL variant relies on cytology (nucleoli), cyclin D3 and MAP2K1 mutation profile.
HSTCL shows sinusoidal red pulp infiltration by T cells (CD3+, TCR gamma-delta) with isochromosome 7q rather than B-cell markers.
